The '''Lerantha Lurker''' was a legendary [[jurgoran]] that lived within the [[Lerantha Dam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] until the [[Alderaan Civil War]], when it was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lerantha Lurker is the final boss of the bonus mission "Pressure Points" for Imperial players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
